svg.title: DorkOS systems and deployment boundaries
svg.desc: The client reaches the local execution server. Independent space servers serve one or many spaces. Cloud space management uses a separate public server API contract; rollout is independent of local implementation. Marketplace discovery and installation use the same package sources.

div.style: color: rgb(24, 48, 71) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
